name: sap-monitoring-system
description: SAP Basis landscape health dashboard — single Next.js app (App Router) with route-handler API on raw pg, plus the Batch Job Monitor (proxied to a separate FastAPI backend).

scripts.db:reset: docker compose down -v && docker compose up -d
scripts.setup: npm run db:up && npm run migrate && npm run import
scripts.dev: concurrently -n web,worker,batch -c magenta,yellow,green "next dev" "npm run worker" "npm run dev:batch-backend"
